turns.prompt:
Create a spacecraft anomaly chain and subsystem board for a space mission anomaly review. This is a presentation artifact, not an interactive dashboard. Keep it as one spacecraft anomaly chain and subsystem board in the first viewport.

Situation: Mission: Aurora-3. Subsystems power PDU, thermal loop T1, attitude control ACS, downlink D2, payload camera, ground station GS-West, flight rule FR-17.
Current state: Thermal loop T1 pressure low red, PDU stable, ACS wheel 3 jitter amber, D2 downlink intermittent, payload camera safe mode, GS-West pass at 21:40, FR-17 constraint active.
Timeline: 19:05 pressure alarm, 19:22 ACS jitter, 19:40 camera safe, 20:10 downlink drop, 21:40 GS-West pass, 22:00 review board.
Sources: S1 telemetry, S2 fault tree, S3 ACS log, S4 downlink monitor, S5 ground pass plan, S6 flight rule book.

Requirements: 1. The first viewport must be dominated by one coherent visual artifact, not a grid of detached KPI cards. 2. Show the main entities, current states, source markers S1-S6, timeline, legend, and four connected callouts. 3. The callouts must cover T1 pressure low, wheel 3 jitter, camera safe mode, GS-West pass. 4. Use polished domain-appropriate styling with readable labels and no critical overlap.

Reframe it for the mission director. Preserve the anomaly chain; add exactly three flight decisions: keep payload safe, schedule T1 recovery, protect GS-West pass. Add two leader-linked lenses for pressure trend and ACS jitter.

Update at 21:10: D2 downlink stabilizes, ACS jitter clears, T1 pressure remains red, GS-West pass slips to 22:05, payload camera remains safe. Synchronize chain, decisions, timeline, source tags, callouts, and change note. Do not leave ACS jitter active.
Create a flight-readiness review page. Fit anomaly chain, subsystem ledger, source tags S1-S6, confidence markers, and pass timeline in the first viewport.
Add a mission-director tablet preview beside the review page. It must preserve T1 red, D2 stable, ACS clear, GS-West 22:05, payload safe, and source markers.
